description: Searches the machine catalogue of Kessen Maschinenbau (food industry machinery: destackers, lidders, applicators, conveyors, line distributors, egg tray stackers, UV-C disinfection, cutting machines, special machines, marking technology). Returns matching machines and machine groups with description and page URL. Without a query the whole catalogue is returned.

language.description: Language of the results: de (German, default) or en (English)

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "destacker trays", "Deckel aufsetzen", "conveyor frozen meat". Leave empty for the full catalogue.

name: search_machines
title: Search Kessen machines
